# The Dugout

> Explains a football manager's substitution decisions as they happen: who is tiring, what each option is worth in win probability (with a 90% interval and a strength label), and at full time what a different call would have changed. An entry to the Microsoft x Premier League "Inside the Game" hackathon. Every club, player and match is synthetic; nothing is betting-related.

Numbers come from code (a Monte Carlo decision engine on what a club could observe); words come from Microsoft Agent Framework agents on a Microsoft Foundry model, and a code check verifies every number before it is shown. Agents can ask the same engine directly through the MCP server below instead of reading the page.

## Use it

- [MCP server](https://dugout-service.wittypond-73564413.northeurope.azurecontainerapps.io/mcp): Streamable HTTP, stateless, read-only tools match_overview, match_state, price_options and explain_decision (English or Spanish, casual or analyst); explain_decision and price_options carry an MCP App that renders the decision card in hosts that support MCP Apps
- [Broadcast view](https://ashy-ocean-03bdf100f.2.azurestaticapps.net/): the demo match as a TV picture with the decision graphics; add ?t=60 to open at a minute, ?lang=es for Spanish, ?source=live for the Web PubSub feed (the demo match kicks off live on the hour and the half hour, UTC, at 5x speed)
- [Analyst desk](https://ashy-ocean-03bdf100f.2.azurestaticapps.net/desk): pitch, condition bars, timeline and the decision card
- [Fan view](https://ashy-ocean-03bdf100f.2.azurestaticapps.net/fan): one club's card and a vote before the manager's call
- [Cue sheet](https://ashy-ocean-03bdf100f.2.azurestaticapps.net/?cues=json): every broadcast graphic as timed cues, machine-readable

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/lauramiro/the-dugout#readme): pitch, architecture on Azure, agents, MCP setup, results
- [Data contracts](https://github.com/lauramiro/the-dugout/blob/main/docs/data-contracts.md): event, tracking frame, snapshot and decision payload
- [Evaluation](https://github.com/lauramiro/the-dugout/blob/main/docs/evaluation.md): the engine graded against the simulator's true counterfactual gaps

## Optional

- [Narration eval](https://github.com/lauramiro/the-dugout/blob/main/eval/results/narration.md): how often the model's lines pass the check, retries and latency
